title: policy/gates.yaml
description: The level-6 gate settings (Plan 02): the bash gate, the result screen and the classifiers behind them; and the run engine's decide() questions (Plan 03 Task 12), the decisions block, which the harvester asks and which loadPolicy loads apart from the gates. Every key is required: the loader fills no defaults. A gate, or an engine decision that isn't off, may be on only while flags.jev has a classifier (checked by loadPolicy).

bash_gate.description: Screens each bash call a worker makes before it runs.

skip_commands.description: Commands that skip the screen, as argv prefixes (git status). Empty screens every call.

result_screen.description: Screens what a tool returns before the worker reads it.

tools.description: The tools whose results are screened.

max_state_chars.description: The most characters of run state a classifier is shown.

classifiers.description: The models that screen, and what a call to them costs.

unknown_call_usd.description: The cost charged to the run for a Jev call whose usage is unknown.

haiku.description: The fallback when flags.jev.fallback is haiku.

decisions.description: The run engine's decide() questions, asked on the host by the harvester about a head it will push. Advisory: an answer can only hold back Ready to merge or add a note.

mode.description: The operator's switch for the whole block. enforce: each decision acts as by_name sets it; notes: asked and recorded, but no answer holds a PR (a hold becomes a note); off: decision models are off, nothing is asked, held or noted, and the PR, the status comment and the run records say so.

max_calls_per_head.description: Classifier calls for one pushed head, over every harvest of it and every re-ask. A subject past it is not asked, and its decision's on_unscreened applies.

by_name.description: One entry per decision file the engine asks (policy/decisions/<name>.ts), held to the engine's registry (src/engine/decisions.ts ENGINE_DECISIONS).

diff-screen.description: The diff screen: each changed file of a head the harvester will push, in windows of whole lines when long.

mode.description: off: never asked; shadow: asked and recorded, no effect on the PR but its Evidence row; enforce: a hold keeps the PR at Needs your decision, a note goes under Check this yourself.

on_unscreened.description: What a subject no classifier answered does (no key, a provider error, over max_state_chars, content the diff doesn't show, past max_calls_per_head): hold, or note.

skip_paths.description: Globs of changed files never screened (globMatches syntax). Only for a decision whose subjects are changed files.
